reponse: The Go-Live Date is December 7, 2026, provided Tradewell completes its KYC and webhook onboarding five business days before [1]. If the delay is attributable to Quillon, Tradewell receives a credit of 5% of monthly Platform Fees per full week, capped at 25%, as its sole remedy [1]. Tomer Golan owns the cutover end to end on the Quillon side [2], and Ellen is the owner on Tradewell's side [2]. At the kickoff call, Martin said they would rather wait until February than go live in mid-January, while Rachel said December 7 is in the contract [4]. The webhook signature fixes were still in progress, with recertification planned for November 24 [3].
